decisions.reason: The new chooser applies to ETH and USDC wallet payments; it does not change the separate Transak fiat flow.
Choosing between ETH and USDC wallet payments does not alter seedless wallet provisioning for fiat buyers.
USDC becomes one selectable wallet-payment method, but the USDC mint flow and its required behavior remain unchanged.
Payment-method selection does not change the primary mint price or allocation of mint proceeds.
The ETH flow was established in the preceding message; adding a chooser changes the separate selection behavior, not the ETH payment asset or flow.
Allowing wallet users to select ETH or USDC does not change the rule that only successful mint transactions are recorded.
The wallet-payment chooser does not modify the optional tip controls or amounts.
Payment-method choice does not alter allocation of commissions when no referral code is supplied.
The source commits to an interface chooser but does not require any corresponding FAQ disclosure or copy revision.
The source does not request changes to the About page or its description of the mint process.
Wallet-payment selection has no effect on the Chainlink VRF winner-selection mechanism.
Choosing ETH or USDC for mint payment does not change automatic prize payout or winner announcements.
